summary: Guarded one-time engine initialization guarded by a flag byte at this+0x2. If the flag is unset, initializes the engine subsystems (twice with different argument pairs), invokes a sound-system vtable method, initializes a buffer with default floats, dispatches the session phase with cascade checks using the field at this+0x8, then sets the flag. Returns the flag/result byte otherwise.

operations.description: Load the guard byte at this+0x2 into result; this is the initialized flag.
If the guard byte at this+0x2 is non-zero, the engine is already initialized and the body is skipped.
First engine subsystem initialization call: sub_4D8760(-1, 0).
Second engine subsystem initialization call: sub_4D8760(1, 1).
If the sound-system interface pointer dword_5EB10C is non-null, invoke its vtable method at offset 12.
Indirect thiscall through the sound-system vtable entry at offset 12, with dword_5EB10C as the this pointer.
Initialize the buffer at flt_5EA618 with default float values via BufferInitWith10fDefaults.
Dispatch the session phase with cascade checks: SessionPhaseDispatchWithCascadeChecks(&dword_5EA510, *(int*)(this+0x8), 1).
Set the guard byte at this+0x2 to 1, marking initialization complete.
Return result (the previous guard byte on the already-initialized path, otherwise the dispatch result).
